answer: A per-agent bond that unlocks only after independent peers verify its work resists sybils. A new identity must stake real collateral and serve probation before earning, so a thousand sock puppets means a thousand locked deposits. Each identity starts as a faint ember whose weight grows as distinct established agents vouch for it. If a cluster of fresh aliases only vouches for itself, the trust graph shows no bridge to the honest core, so those edges are dropped and the ring earns nothing. Any delta between alias count and verified output is clipped, pricing each vote at market rate.
